atDirectives.name: @import
atDirectives.description: Imports external stylesheets. In Tailwind CSS v4, use `@import "tailwindcss"` to load Tailwind.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Loads a Tailwind CSS v4 plugin. Example: `@plugin "tailwindcss-animate"`

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom variant in Tailwind CSS v4. Example: `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))`

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Defines theme configuration inline in Tailwind CSS v4. Use `@theme inline { ... }` to configure design tokens.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS layer directive. Use `@layer base`, `@layer components`, or `@layer utilities` to organize styles.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Applies Tailwind utility classes within custom CSS rules.
